limitations: Dev Add hediff Cut preparation is not normal combat, TakeDamage, armor, targeting probability or cleave evidence. Nineteenth addition triggered missing-part logic inside original health system.
Direct Dev Missing body part Right hand creates a nonfresh parent and descendants; it does not establish fresh hand bleeding or ordinary hand loss. Only eye stump received ordinary tending.
One patient with inherited permanent torso Stab2 and Optimist/Pyromaniac traits; pain and consciousness are not a clean isolated eye formula sample.
Only left-eye and right-hand paths were exercised. Opposite-side identities and64-node names come from separately frozen anatomy-human static mapping, not mirrored damage trials.
First0.5 cut displays10/10HP; at9.5 cumulative pre-replacement, missing occurs. HP rounding and10% efficiency threshold are explained by static chapter51; UI alone does not expose the float formula.
Missing-part severity0.5 is a serialized default, not remainingHP or the prior cut total. Fields not present remain marked absent, including tendQuality0 after tending.
Fresh expiry90000ticks, infection, death, transplantation, prosthetics, scars and natural regrowth were not tested. Elapsed3800mapticks cannot explain expiry; normal tending completed before then.

Failed early Health clicks, vanished Dev menu, and ineffective Escape cancellation are retained.45anatomy-left-eye-add actions occurred while Cut targeting remained active and did not add wounds; successful additions use anatomy-eye-prep prefix after rightclick033.

No save edits, game file edits, profile switching, God-mode enabling, skill edits, Dev healing or Dev tending. Temporary debug hediff tooltips were restored off. Existing medical bed came from prior God preparation.
Ordinary work permission and medCare changed during test, then restored. Medicine objects and counts remain unchanged. BloodLoss grew during pre-tend bleeding and remained after bleeding stopped.

Portable verification checks retained summaries, identities, field presence, ledger and crops; local mode re-extracts original saves and capture metadata. Neither re-executes gameplay nor performs OCR.

Final pause and equal stopped saves at98320; input released after last retained action. Subsequent collection is offline. AgeTicks observed3801 while map delta3800 is retained as serialized, not rewritten to enforce an assumed tick identity.
